item: The request-body shape of every state-changing operation is pinned by route: 165 JSON / 148 none / 4 multipart, three handlers that parse the body themselves
summary: tests/test_request_body_shapes_pinned.py fails by route name when an operation declares a body shape other than JSON, nothing or multipart; when the multipart set (4 on a full install, 3 without the [analysis] extra, where the commodity price import is unmounted) changes; when a function outside the table reads a request body, stream or form (AST scan of src/); or when a per-shape count falls below its per-profile floor (165/148/4 full; 156/147/3 Core-only). The scan found two readers the schema hides inside the 'declares no body' group: POST /api/newsletters/import and POST /api/documents/pdf/upload parse request.form() themselves and answer 200 to any Content-Type or none, an empty POST get-or-creating the newsletter source row; with POST /api/claims/trail-bundle/verify (raw ZIP) that is three. Behind them stands the Origin layer alone; the 415 / declared-UploadFile narrowing is a proposal in the audit folder, not decided (R189, R315). The lesson records that the first table (one raw reader) was wrong until an AST scan replaced the text grep.
